Distribution. Mites of the new genus Baikalozercon are restricted in distribution to the mountains of Southern Siberia. Baikalozercon dracunculus is known from three localities: “ Stolby ” Nature Reserve in Eastern Sayan; Khamar-Daban Ridges in Baikal Region (Buryatia and Irkutskaya Oblast); and Sokhondinskii Nature Reserve in Zabaikalskii Krai, while B. irbis is found only in the highlands of Khamar-Daban Ridge (Fig. 64). Photos of localities along altitudinal gradient of Khamar-Daban Ridge are shown in Figures 65 – 71. Two species of the new genus Baikalozercon coexist on the same Khamar-Daban Ridge, but inhabit different altitudes — B. dracunculus occurs at altitudes of 500 – 700 m a. s. l. in mountain taiga and B. irbis at 1000 – 1600 m in alpine sparse forest with meadow and alpine tundra (Fig. 72).
